source.title: The Enemy of my Enemy
source.description:
I was sent here, along with a mage, to steal the Blade of Devouring for the Syndicate. As soon as I picked the locks, however, he attacked me. He took the blade for himself, and left me for dead.

The mage's name was Caius. He joined us not long ago; promising to share his knowledge of a powerful ritual in exchange for help with stealing its final reagent.

That traitorous snake, and his ritual, must be stopped. He can't get away with this!
source.objective: A terrible threat is brewing within the Syndicate. Someone at Ravenholdt might know what to do.
source.completion: I see why you've brought this to me, <class>. Troubling news indeed. We must consider our next move carefully. Leave me for a moment, so that I can think.
